Returns a JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) that contains the public keys that can be used to verify the JW...
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/oauth/jwks

Returns a JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) that contains the public keys that can be used to verify the JWT tokens.
